criteria.summary: Critic and mutation sentinel are mandatory required gates.
Critic identity, candidate binding and post-review fingerprint are revalidated.
Mutation catalog digest, candidate, freshness and execution evidence are fail-closed.
Known-bad candidate, catalog, report, gap and exit-code cases are covered.
Raw and packaged reports are required and semantically reopened by the verifier.
Older packages fail closed while historical reports remain unchanged.
Local regression and coverage passed on the final implementation.

limitations: Controlled local scope only; staging and production remain NO_GO.
No real data, external integration, commit, push or deploy was used.
